title: qship config
description: Schema for qship/config.json (and answers/last-run.json). Every key listed here must be present at install time — setup.sh and /qship:configure both write this shape. The build script consumes it via jq and passes the flattened values to envsubst.

company_slug.description: Short identifier used in /tmp/<slug>-qship state paths

user_home.description: Absolute path to user's home dir

codebase_root.description: Absolute path to user's monorepo root

codebase_path_prefix.description: Top-level source-tree dir inside each repo (e.g. src/, app/, packages/)

repos.description: Flexible list of the user's repos. Single-repo apps put one entry. 12-service monorepos put twelve. Skills that need multi-repo coordination iterate this list; skills that need a specific repo flag (has_migrations, runs_locally) filter by that flag at runtime.

name.description: Repo directory name relative to codebase_root (or absolute path)

kind.description: Hint about the repo's role. Free-form — skills only branch on flags below.

schema.description: SQL schema name owned by this repo, null if not applicable

package.description: Python/JS package name for imports inside this repo, null if not applicable

has_migrations.description: Set true if this repo has Alembic migrations; qmigrationdevcheck iterates only over flagged repos

runs_locally.description: Set true if qspinuplocal should start this repo's process for local E2E

is_primary.description: The 'main' repo for skills that need a single default. Exactly one repo should set this.

port.description: Default local dev port (used by qspinuplocal if runs_locally=true)

tracker.description: Issue tracker the ticket-driven skills read from. `jira` uses the Atlassian MCP; `none` means no tracker — you paste the ticket/TRD text or pass a local file path, and skills skip all MCP calls. (linear / github are reserved for future provider support.)

tracker_type.description: Which issue tracker to use. `jira` = Atlassian MCP; `none` = inline/paste-a-file, no tracker MCP required.

jira_project_key.description: Ticket-key prefix used in IDs/branch names/examples (e.g. PROJ, TASK, ABC). Named 'jira_*' for placeholder back-compat; applies to any tracker.

example_ticket_id.description: Example ticket id used in docs (e.g. PROJ-1)

atlassian_cloud_id.description: Atlassian cloudId (jira only; blank to skip — resolved at runtime via getAccessibleAtlassianResources). Not a secret; the Jira credential lives in your Atlassian MCP connection, not here.

gh_host.description: GitHub host (github.com or a GHE hostname)

env_var_names.description: Env-var KEY names for runtime config the user's stack reads (qship skills reference these by name in narrative).

env_service_url_key.description: Env var your services use for an HTTP base-URL (e.g. SERVICE_URL, API_URL)

state_root.description: Where qship stores transient state, e.g. /tmp/<slug>-qship

ngrok_reserved_domain.description: Your ngrok reserved subdomain (blank if not used)

features.description: Boolean opt-ins for stack-specific skill bundles. Setup.sh installs the matching skills only when the flag is true.
